title: 妈来电话了
setting: Your flat, 8 pm, the first cold night of autumn. You've just had instant noodles.

silence.en: Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?
Honestly, this child. Bad signal again?

hangup.zh: 算了，我等会儿再打给你。
hangup.en: Never mind, I'll call you back in a bit.
Mum hung up. She'll try again in five minutes, and then she'll try your roommate.

missed.en: Why aren't you picking up? Answer!

say.en: Tell her you've eaten. (Instant noodles count.)
say.tip: 吃饭了吗 is less a question than a hug. 吃了吃了, said twice, means 'yes, yes, don't worry'.

then.zh: 又吃泡面？那东西一点营养都没有！
then.en: Instant noodles again? There's no goodness in those at all!

ok.zh: 那就好。别老吃外卖啊，不干净。
ok.en: Good. And don't live on takeaway, it isn't clean.

fail.en: Huh? Have you eaten or not?

steps.zh: 那个，你过年什么时候回来呀？
steps.en: So, when are you coming home for New Year?

say.en: She wants to know when you're coming home for New Year. Dodge it: you'll see nearer the time.
answers: 还不知道，到时候再说吧。
say.gloss: Don't know yet. We'll see nearer the time.

not.note: That's 'what are you saying?'. To dodge, it's 到时候再说: we'll see when the time comes.

say.tip: 到时候再说 = we'll see when the time comes: the classic way not to answer a parent.

alts.gloss: I'll definitely be home, don't worry!

ok.zh: 那你早点定啊，票不好抢！
ok.en: Then make your mind up soon. Tickets are hard to get!

0.tip: 再说吧 = we'll see (lit. "talk about it later").

steps.zh: 对了，最近有没有谈对象啊？
steps.en: Oh, and: are you seeing anyone these days?

steps.zh: 你听我说啊，你张阿姨同事家的孩子，人特别好……
steps.en: Now listen. Auntie Zhang's colleague has a kid, a really lovely person...

say.en: She's asking if you're seeing anyone, and lining someone up. Deflect: you're busy, there's no rush.
say.gloss: Work keeps me busy. There's no rush.
say.tip: 不着急 = there's no rush. 您别操心了 = don't you worry about it (操心 = fret over someone).

silence.en: Not saying anything? So there IS someone?

silence.zh: 快跟妈说说，是做什么的？
silence.en: Come on, tell Mum. What do they do?

hangup.zh: 行，不说是吧？我问你同学去。
hangup.en: Fine, you won't tell me? I'll ask your classmates.
Mum hung up. She is now phoning everyone you went to school with.

alts.gloss: Hello? Mum? Bad signal, I can't hear you!

then.zh: 别装了，我听得清清楚楚的。
then.en: Don't pretend. I can hear you perfectly well.

ok.zh: 你看看人家小李，孩子都会打酱油了！
ok.en: Look at Xiao Li: her kid's already old enough to run to the shop!

steps.zh: 行行行，不说这个了。降温了啊，多穿点！
steps.en: Fine, fine, I'll drop it. It's turned cold, so wrap up!

steps.zh: 秋裤穿上没有？袜子穿厚的，出门戴围巾……
steps.en: Are your long johns on? Thick socks. A scarf when you go out...

steps.zh: 别喝冰的，别熬夜，被子盖好，早点睡……
steps.en: No cold drinks, no late nights, keep the duvet on, early to bed...

say.en: Tell her you know, you know.
say.tip: 知道了知道了 = I know, I know. Said twice, it means 'please stop'; 好好好 does the same job.

fail.en: Did you hear what I said?

say.en: Wrap it up: that's it for now, you're hanging up.
say.gloss: OK Mum, that's it for now.
say.tip: 那就这样吧 = right, that's it then: the phone sign-off. 我挂了啊 = I'm hanging up now; the 啊 softens it.

fail.zh: 急什么？我话还没说完呢。
fail.en: What's the rush? I haven't finished.

steps.en: Long johns! You MUST wear your long johns!
Forty minutes later, the call ends. You are wearing long johns.
steps.zh: 四十分钟后，电话终于挂了。你穿上了秋裤。
